# The Six Rites of the Zhou Canon

> Marriage Rites (Jiali, the Rites of Festivity) / The Six Rites of the Zhou Canon · 10 entries

The six procedures recorded in the Shihunli of the Yili — nacai, wenming, naji, nazheng, qingqi and qinying — the textual archetype of the traditional marriage system.

> English bodies available: **10 / 10**. Entries marked `Chinese` link to the Chinese original.
